reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer an unconditional affiliate/successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, substantially-all-assets) assignment right on notice only, matching the preferred position.

24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and change-of-control transfers to Customer's consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a competitor bar, and 24.3 supplies a mutual reasonable-consent standard for other assignments.
24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, Fee-acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, so walk-away territory is avoided.

No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out is consistent. The 'without Customer's consent' qualifier on the competitor bar in 24.2 is a minor sub-element short of an absolute prohibition and is properly noted rather than flagged.
